simulation_summary.limits: No cold-cache, city capacity, operational service, durable throughput or rendering claims. Histograms give bucket upper bounds for queue-action processing, not HTTP requests. Run quantiles describe small repeated-run samples, not per-order tails. Collector wall includes polling and bookkeeping overhead; it is not exact process runtime. A null sampled RSS peak means no positive sample, not zero memory. Incomplete runs excluded from timing quantiles but retained in outcomes.

limits: Complete JSON files are pooled by exact SHA-256 and losslessly gzip compressed. This is benchmark packaging, not a new historical archive or reduced evidence format. Successful headless warmups remain in raw records but not measured distributions. Failed warmups remain visible. Collector wall includes monitoring/bookkeeping; OS real/CPU time is coarse. Null OS/sampled measurements are unavailable, not zero allocations. No capacity extrapolation.
